topic: How to Clean a Toilet Bowl Safely
notes: Keep toilet-bowl cleaner use limited to the bowl unless the product and fixture manufacturer explicitly allow another surface. Follow the cleaner label and toilet manufacturer instructions. Never mix toilet cleaner with bleach, ammonia, acids or another cleaner. Avoid in-tank cleaner recommendations unless the toilet manufacturer permits them.
